  • Method Details

    • parseRmiCallbackPort

      public static int parseRmiCallbackPort (String[] args)
      Parses the --rmiCallback=<port> flag from the given arguments.
      Parameters:
      args - raw program arguments; may be null
      Returns:
      the requested callback port, or 0 if the flag is absent (which makes RMI pick a free random port)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the flag is present but its value is not an integer in the 1..65535 range
